Problem Statement
Print the first five terms of the Fibonacci sequence by directly computing each term from the two before it.
Description
The Fibonacci sequence starts with 0 and 1, and every following term is the sum of the previous two terms. Using variables to hold the first two terms, directly compute the third, fourth and fifth terms one after another using addition, then print all five terms separated by spaces. No loop is required since exactly five terms are needed.
Input Description
This program does not read any input.
Output Description
Print the first five Fibonacci terms, separated by single spaces, on one line.
Sample Input
(no input)
Sample Output
0 1 1 2 3
